description.value: dbt Labs empowers data teams to build reliable, governed data pipelines.
dbt Labs is a Philadelphia company, founded in 2016 as Fishtown Analytics, that makes dbt (data build tool) and sells a hosted version of it.

product_description.value: dbt combines SQL-based development with real-time validation. According to the site, dbt never stores your data.
dbt is an open-source framework for transforming data already in a warehouse using SQL and Python. Users write SQL select statements, and dbt adds version control, testing and documentation.

business_model_description.value: The company maintains both the open-source dbt Core project (Apache 2.0 license) and the commercial dbt Cloud managed service.

customer_description.value: Named customers include phData, Nasdaq, Affirm, Toyota, Omni, CHG Healthcare, Siemens and Infinite Lambda.
Sources differ: over 40,000 companies use dbt, while another says more than 60,000 data teams use it, including those at Siemens, Roche and Condé Nast.

revenue.value: More than $100 million in annual recurring revenue (company announcement, February 2025)
